Main finding: "7-state" describes only the first A2A draft, from 2025-04-09 to 2025-05-20. Every tagged version from v0.2.0 through v0.2.5 has 9 string states. v1.0 has 8 real states plus a zero-value `UNSPECIFIED`. The concept name is therefore a historical label, not a description of the current spec.
